Motivation: Why Monolithic Instruction Files Break at Scale Most AI-assisted engineering setups start with a single `GEMINI.md` or `CLAUDE.md` file and steadily accrete rules after every bug. Across real production multi-service workspaces, monolithic instruction files fail in six predictable ways: | Failure Mode | What Goes Wrong in Practice | |---|---| | **1. Context-Window Pollution** | Stuffing universal coding rules, Python/TS/K8s style guides, CI/CD runbooks, and database gotchas into a single `15–50 KB` always-on file burns **`4,000–13,000+` tokens on every turn**—even for a 10-second status question. | | **2. Middle-Context Attention Dilution** | Long prose paragraphs and verbose `` blocks bury critical `🔴` red lines in the middle of the system prompt, causing models to skip verification steps or drop items from multi-part user prompts. | | **3. Self-Review Confirmation Bias** | When a single agent reviews its own code—or when a reviewer subagent reads the author's persuasive commit rationale—anchoring bias causes it to rationalize edge-case bugs instead of falsifying behavior. | | **4. Tautological, Flaky & Silently-Skipped Tests** | Agents routinely write existence-only assertions (`assert res is not None`), use `sleep(0.5)` in async tests, mock the System Under Test, or treat `"0 tests collected"` / `"N skipped"` as a passing test suite. | | **5. Cross-Session Amnesia & Stale Handoffs** | Hard-won architectural constraints vanish between sessions, while unverified session handoff notes go stale and contradict live `git status`, risking accidental destruction of uncommitted developer WIP. | | **6. Copy-Paste Drift & Double-Loading** | Copying `.agents/rules/` across 5–20 repositories guarantees instant version drift—and in Antigravity, copying global rules into a workspace **injects both files simultaneously**, silently doubling token usage. | --- ## 2. Origins & Inspiration (`bobmatnyc/claude-mpm`) — Why `0` Wrapper Code `agy-mpm-kit` is deeply inspired by Bob Matsuoka's pioneering open-source [**`bobmatnyc/claude-mpm`**](https://github.com/bobmatnyc/claude-mpm) framework, along with [**`claude-mpm-agents`**](https://github.com/bobmatnyc/claude-mpm-agents) and [**`claude-mpm-skills`**](https://github.com/bobmatnyc/claude-mpm-skills). ### Why `claude-mpm` Required a Python CLI Wrapper — And Why Antigravity Does Not In Claude Code, `claude-mpm` had to grow into a ~250-file Click/FastAPI/Socket.IO Python wrapper around the CLI binary because: 1. Claude Code plugins initialized *after* system prompt assembly and could not inject top-level orchestration rules pre-turn. 2. An upstream model-routing bug ignored subagent frontmatter `model:` fields, requiring Python `PreToolUse` hooks to route model tiers. 3. Subagents were stateless one-shot calls (`~95K`-token cold reload on every lint/test rework), and monitoring required an external Socket.IO + Svelte web server. **Google Antigravity solves 100% of that infrastructure natively.** As a result, `agy-mpm-kit` ships **`0` lines of Python CLI, daemon, Socket.IO, or hook-wrapper code**: | Capability | `claude-mpm` (`v6.5+`) | `agy-mpm-kit` on Google Antigravity | |---|---|---| | **Pre-Turn Rule Loading & Progressive Disclosure** | Python CLI wrapper assembling system prompts + `build-agent.py` | Native pre-turn `GEMINI.md` / `.agents/rules/*.md` / Plugin `rules/` with `always_on`, `model_decision`, `glob`, and `manual` triggers + `@[label](path)` includes | | **Dynamic Subagent Model & Sandbox Routing** | Python `PreToolUse` hook (`model_tier_hook.py`) | Native `invoke_subagent(Model="flash_lite"\|"flash"\|"pro"\|"inherit", Workspace="inherit"\|"branch"\|"share")` | | **Rework Continuation & Live Subagent UI** | Stateless re-dispatch + external Socket.IO/Svelte monitor | Stateful subagents woken reactively via **`send_message(Recipient=conversationId)`** (zero cold reload!) + native Subagents/Tasks UI | | **Strategic Planning, Autonomous & Learning Flows** | Custom CLI commands & hook scripts | Native `/plan`, `/grill-me`, `/boost`, `/teamwork`, `/goal`, `/compact`, `/learn` + cross-surface `/kit-bootstrap`, `/kit-architecture` & `/kit-handoff` skills | | **Real-World Dirty-Tree & Multi-Repo Safety** | Mandates `ONE FILE PER COMMIT`, auto-commits every phase, and assumes root `.git` | **Upgraded**: Protects dirty user WIP, enforces explicit-path `git add `, and checks `/.git` for multi-repo non-git umbrellas | --- ## 3. Twelve Core Innovations Inside `agy-mpm-kit` ### 1. Caveman Table-Driven Prompt Compression & HSDF Messaging Grounded in empirical MPM benchmarks where converting verbose prose rules (`47 KB` / `~12.7K` tokens) into dense decision tables (`10.8 KB` / `~2.7K` tokens) cut system-prompt tokens by **`-77%`**, reduced total session tokens by **`-47%`**, and **improved QA rubric adherence by `+17%` (`3.75/5 -> 4.40/5`)**. Subagent delegations use **HSDF (Hybrid Structured Delegation Format)** (`tier`, `Effort`, `task`, `scope_allowlist`, `contracts`, `observable`, `return`, `context`), keeping prompts compact while never compressing exact file paths, line numbers, tool names, or stack traces. ### 2. Two-Tier Architecture (Universal Core vs Thin Project Adapter) Separates **Tier 1 (`agy-mpm-core` Global Plugin)**—which is byte-for-byte identical across Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, JVM/.NET, Frontend UI, and Kubernetes projects—from **Tier 2 (Thin Per-Repo Project Adapter)** generated by `/kit-bootstrap`. Session-start baseline overhead stays at **`~3.8K` tokens** (`<20%` of Antigravity's `20,000`-token `defaultRulesBudget`), while stack-specific `glob` rules (`20..28`) consume **`0` tokens** until matching files are active. ### 3. Context-Isolated Adversarial `code-critic` `agents/code-critic.md` defines a dedicated Checker subagent restricted to `[read_file, run_command, manage_task, send_message]` (omitting `edit_file` and `write_file` for tool-surface hygiene). When invoked, the orchestrator **strips the Maker's narrative rationale and commit prose**, supplying only requirements, contracts, `git diff`, raw test stdout, and the exact runtime observable. `code-critic` applies a strict **`>=80%` confidence filter**, enforces a strictness-upgraded verdict rule (**any `CRITICAL` or `HIGH` defect => mandatory `BLOCK`**), and runs automatic **OWASP + multi-tenant security audits** whenever diffs touch auth/JWT, crypto/secrets, SQL/NoSQL queries, shell execution, file uploads/paths, deserialization, or tenant boundaries. ### 4. 5-Phase Systematic Debugging + 3-Strike Circuit Breaker Bans guess-and-patch debugging in `02-code-debug-and-critic.md` by enforcing five sequential gates: **1. Reproduce deterministically -> 2. Isolate (`git bisect` / minimal repro) -> 3. Trace Root Cause backward -> 4. Fix Root Cause (banning symptom-masking `try/catch`, arbitrary sleeps, or blind retries) -> 5. Add Deterministic Regression Test**. If **3 attempts** fail on the same bug, test, or subagent loop, `00-core-guardrails.md` trips the **3-Strike Stop Rule**: stop patching in circles, summarize falsified hypotheses, question the architectural assumption, and escalate options to the user. ### 5. 6-Point Analytical & Data Forensics Visible Self-Check Whenever an agent produces metrics, cloud cost/utilization reports, database count/rate queries, benchmarks, or log forensics, `03-analytical-forensics.md` mandates an explicit **`Visible Self-Check`** footer auditing: (1) Dimensional & Unit Consistency (`s` vs `ms`, `MiB` vs `GiB`, base64 wire expansion `× 4/3`), (2) Time-Series Aggregation Semantics (weighting bursty gauges by runtime rather than summing window means / `avg_over_time`), (3) Denominator & Population Survival (`deleted: false`), (4) Control Cohort Baseline, (5) Artifact Over Abstraction, and (6) Single-Hypothesis Falsification. ### 6. Test Quality Inspector & 3-Level Contract Pyramid Combines `00-core-guardrails.md` and `20-domain-tests-and-contracts.md` to eliminate hollow test suites: - **Silent-Skip & Target-Env Guard**: `"0 tests collected"`, `"N skipped"` on target code, empty stdout, or running outside the repo's real virtual environment/toolchain **fails** verification immediately. - **Anti-Tautology & Mental Mutation Check**: Bans `assert res is not None` / `toBeDefined()` and requires checking *"if I invert the target `if` branch or shift `<` to `<=`, does at least one test fail?"* - **Deterministic Async & Clean Prod Boundaries**: Bans fixed wall-clock `sleep()` / `setTimeout()` in favor of bounded condition polling (`waitFor`), bans mocking internal SUT methods, and bans `_for_testing()` methods on production classes. - **3-Level Contract Pyramid**: Layers (L1) Postcondition & boundary unit tests, (L2) Generator-encoded property-based tests (`hypothesis` / `fast-check`), and (L3) Negative precondition tests. ### 7. Dirty-Tree Git & Non-Git Multi-Repo Umbrella Safety Built for real developer workspaces with uncommitted WIP and multi-repository parent folders: - **WIP & Secret Protection**: Bans `git checkout `, `git restore `, `git reset --hard`, `git clean`, and wildcard staging (`git add .`, `git add -A`, `git commit -a`). Enforces explicit-path staging (`git add path/a path/b`), pre/post `git status -s` + `git show --stat HEAD` audits, and guilty-until-verified secret stops (`sk-`, `ghp_`, `AKIA`, `npm_`, `xox`, `AIza`, PEM). - **`/.git` Precondition**: Verifies `/.git` exists *before* passing `Workspace="share"` or `"branch"` to `invoke_subagent`. In non-git multi-repo umbrella directories (where `.git` lives inside child `/.git` folders), agents automatically use `Workspace="inherit"` with disjoint sub-repo ownership or explicit `git -C worktree add`—preventing immediate worktree crashes and fake root `.git/info/exclude` files. ### 8. Bounded 5-Section `FIFO` `memories.md` (`<=4 KB`) + Chronological Authority Matrix `04-memory-knowledge-adr.md` automatically captures persistent user directives (`"remember"`, `"always"`, `"never"`, `"going forward"`) as single-line ISO-dated facts (`- [YYYY-MM-DD] `) across 5 bounded sections: `CRITICAL` (max `20`, never auto-evicted), `Environment` (`15`), `Decisions` (`20`), `Patterns` (`20`), and `Gotchas` (`15`), using deterministic **FIFO (oldest-first) eviction** within a **`<=4 KB`** cap. Multi-paragraph lessons graduate to `postmortems.md` under a **Chronological Authority Matrix (`00-INDEX.md`)** where newer verified timestamps + live code win on conflict, paired with a **3-Gate Nygard ADR filter** and `/learn` integration. ### 9. Redacted 7-Section Session Handoffs (`LATEST.md`) `/kit-handoff pause` is advisory and fail-open (never killing in-flight background subagents). It scans and redacts secrets to `` before writing a compact, gitignored 7-section snapshot (`.agents/handoffs/LATEST.md`, `<=10K` tokens). On `/kit-handoff resume`, the agent **mandatory-reconciles `LATEST.md` against live `git status -s` and `git log --oneline -10`** so live repository state always overrides stale handoff prose. ### 10. Clean Architecture, Anti-God-File, DRY, OOP/Design Patterns & Polyglot Packs (`20..28` + `/kit-architecture`) Prevents AI-generated spaghetti, copy-paste proliferation, and monolithic files while distinguishing **Production Mainline** code (default) from **Throwaway Prototypes / `scratch/`** (`<200–300` LOC single-file allowed, banned from mainline imports): - **Hard Size & Complexity Caps (`02` + `code-critic`)**: Plans modular splits at **`400` LOC** (hard cap **`600` LOC** per file), **`<=300` LOC** per class (`<=200` LOC UI components), **`<=30/50` LOC** per function, cyclomatic complexity **`<=10`**, and nesting depth **`<=3`** via guard clauses. - **Search-Before-Create & DRY Consolidation**: Mandates searching existing helpers first, **One Implementation Per Feature** (deleting superseded dead code), and extracting reusable functions/collaborators whenever **`2+` same-domain blocks exceed `>80%` similarity** or **`>=30` LOC** (while guarding against wrong-DRY cross-domain coupling). - **Problem-First OOP, SOLID & Design Patterns**: Enforces Composition over Inheritance (`depth <=2`), Constructor Dependency Injection, and concrete smell-to-pattern mappings (`3+` repeated `if/else`/`switch` chains -> **Strategy / Handler Registry**, persistence leakage -> **Repository**, external 3rd-party APIs -> **Adapter / Anti-Corruption Layer**, complex assembly -> **Factory / Builder**, cyclic calls -> **Domain Events**, slow upstream cascades -> **Circuit Breaker**). - **Zero-Idle-Cost Polyglot Best Practices**: Ships `9` `trigger: glob` domain packs (`20..28`: Tests/Contracts, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, K8s/Infra, SQL/MongoDB, Go, Rust, Java/Kotlin/C# `.NET`, and React/Next/Vue/Svelte Frontend UI) plus the progressive-disclosure `/kit-architecture` skill covering **12 language ecosystems** (`+ PHP, Ruby, Elixir/OTP, Swift/Dart, C/C++`) and safe `<=200`-LOC chunked God-file refactoring. ### 11. 3-Mode Orchestration (`T0` Inline, `teamwork`/`swarm` Exact Model+Effort Pinning & Live `Promote-on-Review`) Solves the fundamental limitation of standard `invoke_subagent` (which is restricted to 4 coarse tier aliases and exposes no API-level thinking effort control) by establishing three distinct execution modes across `01-orchestration.md`, `02-code-debug-and-critic.md`, and `agents/code-critic.md`: - **Mode 1 — Direct Inline (`T0`)**: Zero subagent overhead for `<=3` file reads, quick Q&A, and trivial `<20` LOC single-step edits in the Main Agent. - **Mode 2 — Exact Model + Effort Multi-Agent Flow (`teamwork` & Native `swarm`)**: Required whenever a project (`GEMINI.md`/`AGENTS.md`) defines exact role profiles, featuring the **Velocity-Optimized 5-Role Matrix** to eliminate multi-agent turn latency: * **1. Orchestrator (`Sentinel`, `teamwork_orchestrator`)**: ` (High)` — prevents coordination and dispatch latency bottlenecks. * **2. Researcher & Analyst (`teamwork_explorer`)**: ` (Medium)` — cuts deep exploration latency while retaining frontier analytical depth. * **3. Developer & Tester (`teamwork_worker`)**: ` (High)` — rapid coding and test execution; escalates to ` (High)` on `Promote-on-Review` (2 Stage 3.5 stalls or reviewer `BLOCK`). * **4. Reviewers of All Kinds (`code-critic`, `teamwork_reviewer`, `teamwork_challenger`, `teamwork_victory_auditor`)**: ` (High)` — maximum frontier rigor unconditionally for every verification gate. * **5. Task Setter / Spec Author (`teamwork_interviewer`)**: ` (Medium)` — structured problem framing without `High` overhead (bypassed via `[skip-interview]` when requirements are concrete). * **Built-in `teamwork` Flow (`/teamwork`)**: Enforces the **Prompt-Top Matrix Rule (`🔴`)** by prepending the workspace's Role -> Model + Effort Matrix verbatim at the prompt top (`teamwork` subagents cannot see parent conversation history). Supports **`[skip-interview]`** for rapid execution when specs are concrete (`>=90%`), single-iteration workers with unanchored promotion (`iterN+1` at `+1/+2` tiers on Stage 3.5 stall or reviewer `BLOCK`), and strict `.gitignore` tracking for `.agents/teamwork/`. * **`teamwork` Anti-Latency Guardrails (`🟡`)**: Reserves full multi-stage `teamwork` pipelines for multi-step campaigns (`>=3` files or cross-module workflows), defaults to `[skip-interview]` when clear, and pairs Knowledge-First Boot with Cache-First gates to eliminate redundant discovery loops. * **Native `swarm` Flow**: Leverages native swarm catalog discovery (`swarm{action:"models"}`), pins exact model+effort per worker (`swarm{action:"add"}`), and performs **live in-place promotion** (`swarm{action:"model"}`) on waiting workers without losing conversation context. - **Mode 3 — Coarse `invoke_subagent` Fallback (`flash_lite | flash | pro | inherit`)**: Follows the `T1..T3` pre-dispatch rubric with Maker `1–2` tiers below max and Checker at top tier (`pro` + `High`). Spawns a fresh higher-tier subagent on `Promote-on-Review`. - **Knowledge-First Subagent Boot (`🔴`)**: Eliminates wasteful cold surveys by requiring parent orchestrators to pass `knowledge_refs:` (`GEMINI.md`, `00-INDEX.md`, `memories.md`, and topic guides) in every prompt/dispatch/brief. Subagents read these in Step 0 before scanning files, skipping blind discovery waves when architectural context already exists. - **Cache-First Gate (`🟡`)**: When `>=75%` of requested analytics or report data exists in local cached files, agents slice/render cached data directly rather than spawning heavy top-tier subagents to recompute from scratch. ### 12. Reference-Aware `Read-Once` & `Symbol-First` Reading Protocol Stops context-window pollution, token waste, and turn latency caused by redundant re-reads, unreferenced curiosity browsing, or blind micro-stepping across large files: - **Mode-Calibrated Read Scope (Zero Foot-Guns)**: * **Targeted Coding & Bugfixes**: Directs agents to inspect `scope_allowlist` + target tests + **any real code references** (`imports`, base classes, interfaces, callers/callees, shared types/configs) across files to whatever hop depth is required for call-chain correctness. Bans *only* unreferenced curiosity reads (unrelated sibling implementations, other-environment configs, blanket directory dumps) lacking a code reference or search hit. * **General Analysis, DRY & Similarity Audits**: Cross-module `grep -rn` and multi-file pattern reads are **explicitly unrestricted**—agents discover candidates via `00-INDEX.md` + `grep -rn` first, then inspect exact matched regions. - **4 Universal Anti-Waste Rules (for All Agents)**: 1. **`Read-Once` (No Duplicate Reads)**: Never re-read an unchanged `(file, line_range)` twice in the same conversation; keep read signatures and contracts in working notes until disk edits invalidate them. 2. **No Blind 100-Line Stepping**: For cohesive files `<=600–800` lines, fetch the needed scope in **1** `read_file` call (up to tool max `800` lines) rather than stepping `1-100`, `101-200`, `201-350`. 3. **`Grep-Before-Read` on Large Files (`>400` lines)**: Run `grep -n` first to pinpoint exact symbol/reference line numbers, then fetch **1** targeted block per needed symbol/call-site (including when jumping across `import` references into another large file). 4. **`read_anchors:` Handoff (`Explorer -> Developer`)**: `Explorer` and `Task Setter` deliverables (`handoff.md`, `DISPATCH.md`) pass exact `path:start-end | symbol | key_refs` anchors in HSDF delegations so Developers start on target lines immediately without cold re-exploration (while remaining fully free to follow newly discovered code references). --- ## 4. Motivation: Why Monolithic Instruction Files Break at Scale Most AI-assisted engineering setups start with a single `GEMINI.md` or `CLAUDE.md` file and steadily accrete rules after every bug. Across real production multi-service workspaces, monolithic instruction files fail in six predictable ways: | Failure Mode | What Goes Wrong in Practice | |---|---| | **1. Context-Window Pollution** | Stuffing universal coding rules, Python/TS/K8s style guides, CI/CD runbooks, and database gotchas into a single `15–50 KB` always-on file burns **`4,000–13,000+` tokens on every turn**—even for a 10-second status question. | | **2. Middle-Context Attention Dilution** | Long prose paragraphs and verbose `` blocks bury critical `🔴` red lines in the middle of the system prompt, causing models to skip verification steps or drop items from multi-part user prompts. | | **3. Self-Review Confirmation Bias** | When a single agent reviews its own code—or when a reviewer subagent reads the author's persuasive commit rationale—anchoring bias causes it to rationalize edge-case bugs instead of falsifying behavior. | | **4. Origins & Inspiration (`bobmatnyc/claude-mpm`) — Why `0` Wrapper Code `agy-mpm-kit` is deeply inspired by Bob Matsuoka's pioneering open-source [**`bobmatnyc/claude-mpm`**](https://github.com/bobmatnyc/claude-mpm) framework, along with [**`claude-mpm-agents`**](https://github.com/bobmatnyc/claude-mpm-agents) and [**`claude-mpm-skills`**](https://github.com/bobmatnyc/claude-mpm-skills). ### Why `claude-mpm` Required a Python CLI Wrapper — And Why Antigravity Does Not In Claude Code, `claude-mpm` had to grow into a ~250-file Click/FastAPI/Socket.IO Python wrapper around the CLI binary because: 1. Claude Code plugins initialized *after* system prompt assembly and could not inject top-level orchestration rules pre-turn. 2. An upstream model-routing bug ignored subagent frontmatter `model:` fields, requiring Python `PreToolUse` hooks to route model tiers. 3. Subagents were stateless one-shot calls (`~95K`-token cold reload on every lint/test rework), and monitoring required an external Socket.IO + Svelte web server. **Google Antigravity solves 100% of that infrastructure natively.** As a result, `agy-mpm-kit` ships **`0` lines of Python CLI, daemon, Socket.IO, or hook-wrapper code**: | Capability | `claude-mpm` (`v6.5+`) | `agy-mpm-kit` on Google Antigravity | |---|---|---| | **Pre-Turn Rule Loading & Progressive Disclosure** | Python CLI wrapper assembling system prompts + `build-agent.py` | Native pre-turn `GEMINI.md` / `.agents/rules/*.md` / Plugin `rules/` with `always_on`, `model_decision`, `glob`, and `manual` triggers + `@[label](path)` includes | | **Dynamic Subagent Model & Sandbox Routing** | Python `PreToolUse` hook (`model_tier_hook.py`) | Native `invoke_subagent(Model="flash_lite"\|"flash"\|"pro"\|"inherit", Workspace="inherit"\|"branch"\|"share")` | | **Rework Continuation & Live Subagent UI** | Stateless re-dispatch + external Socket.IO/Svelte monitor | Stateful subagents woken reactively via **`send_message(Recipient=conversationId)`** (zero cold reload!) + native Subagents/Tasks UI | | **Strategic Planning, Autonomous & Learning Flows** | Custom CLI commands & hook scripts | Native `/plan`, `/grill-me`, `/boost`, `/teamwork`, `/goal`, `/compact`, `/learn` + cross-surface `/kit-bootstrap`, `/kit-architecture` & `/kit-handoff` skills | | **Real-World Dirty-Tree & Multi-Repo Safety** | Mandates `ONE FILE PER COMMIT`, auto-commits every phase, and assumes root `.git` | **Upgraded**: Protects dirty user WIP, enforces explicit-path `git add `, and checks `/.git` for multi-repo non-git umbrellas | --- ## 3. Twelve Core Innovations Inside `agy-mpm-kit` ### 1. Caveman Table-Driven Prompt Compression & HSDF Messaging Grounded in empirical MPM benchmarks where converting verbose prose rules (`47 KB` / `~12.7K` tokens) into dense decision tables (`10.8 KB` / `~2.7K` tokens) cut system-prompt tokens by **`-77%`**, reduced total session tokens by **`-47%`**, and **improved QA rubric adherence by `+17%` (`3.75/5 -> 4.40/5`)**. Subagent delegations use **HSDF (Hybrid Structured Delegation Format)** (`tier`, `Effort`, `task`, `scope_allowlist`, `contracts`, `observable`, `return`, `context`), keeping prompts compact while never compressing exact file paths, line numbers, tool names, or stack traces. ### 2. Two-Tier Architecture (Universal Core vs Thin Project Adapter) Separates **Tier 1 (`agy-mpm-core` Global Plugin)**—which is byte-for-byte identical across Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, JVM/.NET, Frontend UI, and Kubernetes projects—from **Tier 2 (Thin Per-Repo Project Adapter)** generated by `/kit-bootstrap`. Day-to-Day Workflows ### 7.1 Onboarding a New Repository (`/kit-bootstrap --lite` vs `--full`) - **`/kit-bootstrap --lite`** *(~90s — small libraries, CLIs, `<5` modules)*: Scans stack manifests (`package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`, etc.) and `git log`, asks **one** confirmation question via `ask_question`, and creates a compact plain-Markdown `GEMINI.md` (`~1.8 KB`), seeded `.agents/knowledge/memories.md`, and `.gitignore` entry for `.agents/handoffs/`. - **`/kit-bootstrap --full`** *(~90s — production services, monorepos, multi-repo umbrellas, K8s/cloud)*: Adds `.agents/rules/10-project-operations.md` (`model_decision` — keeping CI/CD, K8s rollout, namespace, and secret runbooks out of pure coding turns), optional `.agents/rules/11-project-confidentiality.md` (`always_on`), and `.agents/knowledge/{00-INDEX.md, active-tasks.md, postmortems.md}`. - **Automatic `--migrate` Safety Upgrade**: If `/kit-bootstrap --lite` or `--full` detects any pre-existing agent instruction files in the workspace, it **automatically switches to `--migrate`** so existing project rules are never silently overwritten. ### 7.2 Migrating Existing Repositories Losslessly (`/kit-bootstrap --migrate`) Consolidates legacy or cross-agent setups into a clean Tier-2 Project Adapter in five verified steps: 1. **Exhaustive Discovery**: Scans `GEMINI.md`, `AGENTS.md` (root & nested), `.agents/rules/*.md`, legacy `.agents/workflows/*.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**`, `.cursorrules`, `.cursor/rules/**`, `.windsurfrules`, `CODEX.md`, `.remember/**`, and agent sections in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. 2. **Lossless Backup Gate**: Copies every discovered file preserving relative paths into `/brain//scratch/rule-migration-backup/` before touching a single workspace byte. 3. **4-Bucket Triage Matrix**: - *Bucket 1 (Universal Core Duplicates)* -> **Dropped** (already covered by `00..04` & `20..28`, immediately reclaiming prompt tokens). - *Bucket 2 (Behavioral Conflicts)* -> **Surfaced via `ask_question`** (e.g., unsafe auto-commits or skipped tests). - *Bucket 3 (Always-On Identity & Red Lines)* -> **Condensed** into plain-Markdown `GEMINI.md` (or shared `AGENTS.md` for multi-tool Claude + Cursor + Antigravity teams). - *Bucket 4 (Ops, Subdir Rules, Lore & Workflows)* -> **Structured** into `10-project-operations.md` (`model_decision`), `11-project-confidentiality.md` (`always_on`), optional `12-.md` (`trigger: glob`, `globs: "**//**"`), `.agents/knowledge/*`, and converts legacy `.agents/workflows/*.md` into `.agents/skills//SKILL.md`. 4. **Single `ask_question` Confirmation**: Confirms triage plan, collaboration mode (Mode A / B / C / multi-tool `AGENTS.md`), and confidentiality rule inclusion. 5. **Mandatory `code-critic` Lossless Verification Audit**: Spawns `code-critic` (`Model="pro"`, `Effort: High`) to diff the generated adapter against `scratch/rule-migration-backup/`, blocking completion unless **0 project invariants, canonical commands, regexes, namespace maps, or links were lost**. ### 7.3 Pausing, Resuming & Compounding Knowledge (`/kit-handoff` & `/learn`) - **`/kit-handoff pause`**: Checks active background tasks/subagents without interrupting them, redacts credentials (`sk-`, `ghp_`, `AKIA`, `npm_`, `xox`, `AIza`, PEM, Bearer tokens), ensures `.agents/handoffs/` is gitignored, and writes `.agents/handoffs/LATEST.md` (`<=10K` tokens). Recommends `/compact` if continuing in a long chat. - **`/kit-handoff resume`**: Reads `LATEST.md` + `memories.md` and **reconciles them against live `git status -s` and `git log --oneline -10`** (across root `.git` or child `*/*/.git` sub-repos). Live Git state always wins over stale handoff notes. - **`/kit-handoff postmortem`**: Audits session errors, `code-critic` `BLOCK` verdicts, and 3-strike pivots from session logs, records 1-line `FIFO`-bounded lessons in `memories.md` (+ detailed timelines in `postmortems.md`), and recommends Antigravity's native **`/learn`** command when a lesson warrants a permanent cross-repo rule or skill. ### 7.4 Clean Architecture, Safe God-File Refactoring & Polyglot Best Practices (`/kit-architecture`) - **`/kit-architecture audit [path]`**: Quantitatively scans files `>400/600` LOC, classes `>300` LOC, functions `>50` LOC, deep nesting `>3`, `>80%` duplicated blocks, concrete I/O coupled inside domain classes, and repeated type-tag switches, separating **Production Mainline** from `scratch/` prototypes. - **`/kit-architecture refactor `**: Decomposes monolithic `600–5,000+` LOC files in behavior-preserving **`<=200` LOC chunks** with pre/post test gates, **One Implementation Per Feature** dead-code cleanup, and `Added / Removed / Net LOC` reporting. - **`/kit-architecture patterns [problem]` & `/kit-architecture lang `**: Consults progressive-disclosure references for problem-first OOP/SOLID pattern selection and idiomatic engineering across **12 language ecosystems** (`Python`, `TypeScript/Node`, `Go`, `Rust`, `Java/Kotlin`, `C#/.NET`, `React/Next/Vue/Svelte`, `PHP`, `Ruby`, `Elixir/OTP`, `Swift/Dart`, `C/C++`). ### 7.5 Synergy with Built-In Antigravity Slash Commands | Scenario | Recommended Command | |---|---| | Align on architecture or ambiguous requirements before coding (`>500` LOC) | `/plan` or `/grill-me` | | Deep multi-perspective reasoning & rigorous verification on hard problems | `/boost` | | Coordinated autonomous multi-agent execution across a large project | `/teamwork` or `/goal` | | Free up context window mid-session (pair with `/kit-handoff pause`) | `/compact` | | Promote a project discovery into a reusable global skill or rule | `/learn` | --- ## 8.
